title: Squares, three times
prompt: Write `print_square`, which takes a number and prints it multiplied by itself. In `solve`, call it with n, then n + 1, then n + 2, so solve(1) prints 1, 4, 9.
hints: Writing the squaring once in a function saves repeating it three times.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
